title: Milestone 5: Stanza Router & In-Memory Offline Store (xmpp_router)

mentalModelCheck.question: When routing a stanza to a bare JID with multiple active resources, how does xmpp_router dispatch the message?

options.label: It queries xmpp_session_registry:lookup_by_jid/1, which returns the PID with the highest numerical priority.
options.explanation: Correct! Under RFC 6121, bare JID dispatch routes to the session resource possessing the highest numerical priority, or spools offline if none are online.

options.label: It broadcasts the stanza to every connected user on the server.
options.explanation: Stanzas are strictly routed to the recipient's registered sessions.

options.label: It rejects bare JIDs with an error because full JIDs are required.
options.explanation: Bare JIDs are standard in XMPP; the server resolves them to the active session with highest priority.
